stories.title: IMPD: Man, woman killed in apparent drive-by shooting on Indy's near northeast side
stories.summary: Police said the shooting happened around 10:40 p.m. Nov. 21 in the 3600 block of Grant Avenue, near 38th Street and North Sherman Drive.

stories.title: IMPD: Man injured after shooting on Indy's near southwest side
stories.summary: Police said the shooting happened shortly after 11:30 p.m. Nov. 21 in the 1800 block of West Miller Street, near South Harding Street.

stories.title: Portland police arrest 6 people, including juveniles, after investigation into Jay County burglary
stories.summary: Police said multiple firearms were stolen during the burglary, which reportedly occurred Nov. 17-18 at an unspecified residence in Jay County.

stories.title: Motorcyclist killed in crash with SUV on Indy's south side
stories.summary: Police said the crash happened around 5:18 p.m. Nov. 21 in the 8700 block of U.S. 31 South, near East Stop 13 Road.

stories.title: 10 years after Flora sisters killed in arson fire, family friends continue annual memorial
stories.summary: Family friends gathered Friday at the graves of the four sisters who were killed ten years ago in an intentionally set house fire in Carroll County.

stories.title: Driver found dead after van travels '150 feet through the air' before submerging in creek, investigators say
stories.summary: Investigators are looking into whether a medical emergency contributed to the crash, but so far, the cause of the crash and driver's death are unknown.

stories.title: Silver Alert canceled for 83-year-old man from DeKalb County
stories.summary: Indiana State Police say a Silver Alert sent out Friday evening was canceled.

stories.title: Man killed in single-vehicle crash on Indy's west side
stories.summary: The crash happened in the area of Crawfordsville Road and North Girls School Road shortly after 5 a.m. on Nov. 21.

stories.title: Teen shot, another cut after fight in Avon home with 2 suspects reportedly at large
stories.summary: A 19-year-old man was shot and a 17-year-old was reportedly cut after a fight that happened in the bedroom of an Avon home the night of Nov. 20.

stories.title: 'They were lovely' | Community vigil remembers mother, daughters killed in apparent murder-suicide
stories.summary: Julie Tkach and her daughters, Katharyn and Lauren, died Wednesday. Their neighbors came together Friday to grieve and support one another.

stories.title: Don Marsh, former CEO of Marsh Supermarkets dies at 88
stories.summary: Prominent Indiana businessman Don Marsh died Nov. 17, 2026, at 88. He was born in Muncie and led the family business in 1968.

stories.title: Statewide Silver Alert canceled for missing 67-year-old northeast Indiana woman
stories.summary: The statewide Silver Alert for a missing Kendallville woman has been canceled.
